integrity: The infinite statements are proved symbolically from the matching/independent-set description. Exhaustive direct enumeration of partial maps through \(P_6\) and formula checks through \(P_{14}\) are included only as finite cross-checks.
scientific_limitations: The closed rank formula and rational generating function are proved for path graphs. The general-graph part is only the exact structural characterization of idempotents; no cycle or arbitrary-graph closed count is claimed.
title: Idempotent enumeration in strict Margolis–Rhodes path semigroups
